name: URLs remain verbatim across punctuation and localization
source: 限量 50 套。请访问 https://example.com/Reserve?ref=20&lang=zh 或 http://example.org/條款#VIP。
primary: Only 50 sets are available. Visit (https://example.com/Reserve?ref=20&lang=zh) and http://example.org/條款#VIP.
alt: Limited to 50 sets. Visit https://example.com/Reserve?ref=20&lang=zh and http://example.org/條款#VIP!

name: a changed URL path is rejected
primary: See the details at https://example.com/Reserve?ref=20.
alt: See the details at https://example.com/reserve?ref=20.

name: missing URL in alternate
primary: See the details at https://example.com/offer.
alt: Explore the offer.

name: invented URL in CTA
primary: See the details at https://example.com/offer.
alt: Explore the offer at https://example.com/offer.

name: a missing limited quantity is rejected
primary: 禮盒限量 50 套。
alt: 禮盒現已登場。

name: a limited quantity cannot become an ordinary count
primary: Only 50 gift sets are available.
alt: There are 50 sets on display.

name: first visitors qualifier is required
source: 首 100 名到店客人可獲禮品。
primary: A gift for the first 100 visitors.
alt: A gift for 100 visitors.

name: count, container, and size may be translated
source: 内含 2 瓶，每瓶 100ml，盒长 20 厘米。
primary: The box is 20 cm long and includes two bottles, each 100 milliliters.
alt: Inside the 20-centimetre box are 2 bottles of 100 ml each.

name: a container swap is rejected
primary: 禮盒附有 2 瓶。
alt: 禮盒附有 2 盒。

name: prices may be reordered with their named products
primary: Find our cream at HK$380 and our serum at HK$280.
alt: Cream: HK$380. Serum: HK$280.

name: prices cannot be swapped between two named products
primary: Serum costs HK$280 and cream costs HK$380.
alt: Serum costs HK$380 and cream costs HK$280.

name: keeping price order cannot disguise a swap between known products
primary: Serum costs HK$280 and cream costs HK$380.
alt: Cream costs HK$280 and serum costs HK$380.

name: price order is preserved when translated product anchors do not match
source: 香薰蜡烛售 HK$280，手工托盘售 HK$380。
primary: The scented candle costs HK$280; the handmade tray costs HK$380.
alt: Discover our candle for HK$280 and our handcrafted tray for HK$380.

name: translated multi-item price swap fails the order check
source: 香薰蜡烛售 HK$280，手工托盘售 HK$380。
primary: The scented candle costs HK$280; the handmade tray costs HK$380.
alt: Discover our candle for HK$380 and our handcrafted tray for HK$280.

name: member discount may be translated without repeating it in the CTA
primary: Members save 15%.
alt: Take 15% off with your membership.

name: member qualification is required in both drafts
primary: Members save 15%.
alt: Everyone saves 15%.

name: product lineup membership is ordinary prose
source: 这件新品是春季系列的一员。
primary: Discover the latest member of our spring collection.
alt: Explore the latest addition to our spring collection.

name: shipping scope does not restrict order eligibility
primary: 香氛禮盒，香港免運費。
alt: 香港免運費，訂單僅限香港地區。

name: free shipping may be phrased in natural English
primary: Shop the fragrance set with free shipping in Hong Kong.
alt: Shipping within Hong Kong is on us.

name: shipping scope cannot be omitted
primary: Shop the fragrance set with free shipping in Hong Kong.
alt: Free shipping on the fragrance set.

name: Hong Kong only may describe shipping instead of orders
primary: Free shipping on Hong Kong orders only.
alt: Free shipping within Hong Kong only.

name: invented Hong Kong-only order restriction is rejected in English
primary: Free shipping for orders within Hong Kong.
alt: Free shipping for Hong Kong orders. Orders are restricted to Hong Kong only.

name: apostrophes inside URL paths are preserved
primary: Book at https://example.test/o'reilly.
alt: Book at https://example.test/o'really.

name: an explicitly delimited URL preserves its trailing punctuation
primary: Book at <https://example.test/Offer!>.
alt: Book at <https://example.test/Offer>.

name: explicitly paired product names remain assigned to the right prices
primary: NOVA and LUMA are HK$350 and HK$280, respectively.
alt: Choose LUMA or NOVA at HK$280 and HK$350, respectively.

name: respectively cannot hide a price swap
primary: LUMA costs HK$280. NOVA costs HK$350.
alt: NOVA and LUMA are HK$280 and HK$350, respectively.

name: non-members do not satisfy a member-only claim
primary: Members save 15%.
alt: Non-members save 15%.

name: a rewards or loyalty program qualifies as membership
primary: Members of our loyalty program save 15%.
alt: Take 15% off with your membership.

name: ordering may not be limited to customers in Hong Kong
primary: Free shipping in Hong Kong.
alt: Free shipping in Hong Kong. Only customers in Hong Kong may place orders.

name: a repeated product cannot acquire a conflicting price
primary: LUMA costs HK$280. NOVA costs HK$350.
alt: LUMA HK$280, NOVA HK$350. LUMA HK$350.

name: generic membership updates do not qualify a discount
primary: Members save 15%.
alt: Sign up for membership updates. Take 15% off today.

name: the stock limit qualifier can follow a colon
primary: 禮盒僅50套。
alt: 禮盒有50套。

name: an explicit one can be spelled out in translation
primary: The gift set includes one bottle.
alt: The gift set includes 1 bottle.

name: English token boundaries allow adjacent Han characters
primary: 禮盒only 50 gift sets。
alt: 禮盒僅50套。
